system.description:
An ancient air car: carries 1-6 people and flies 30" per turn. Sides and bottom stop all missiles smaller than a catapult stone; Eyes and spells may get through.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: several rumoured; a 'stable' of five or more said to lie under Tsámra in Livyánu. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
